This is only needed if you're filing an Issue by hand. If you used the

A maintainer reviews every submission before it's added to community-profiles/
in this repo. Please don't include anything you wouldn't want public: no real
IP addresses/hostnames, credentials, or site-identifying details in tag
comments.
